Usage: gotools migrate [options] <unified|split|module>

  Migrate all tools to a different isolation strategy, or move the tools
  directory with --dir. Preserves exact pinned versions across the migration.

  Examples:
    gotools migrate unified
    gotools migrate module --dry-run
    gotools migrate split --dir=gotools

  Options:
    --dir <string>  Move the tools directory to `PATH`, keeping the strategy
    --dry-run       Show what would be migrated without making changes
